title: Full-Stack Engineer Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to go from zero to building complete web features and landing a job. You’ll master core languages, frameworks, databases, and deployment, then showcase real projects.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build the basic programming and web concepts needed for any full‑stack role.

milestones.title: JavaScript & TypeScript Basics
milestones.outcome: Write simple scripts and type‑annotated functions in the browser console.

tasks.title: Read JavaScript fundamentals
tasks.description: Study the “JavaScript Basics” section on MDN, focusing on variables, control flow, and functions.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp ES6 challenges
tasks.description: Solve the first 5 ES6 challenges to practice let/const, arrow functions, and modules.

tasks.title: Write a typed function in TypeScript Playground
tasks.description: Open the TypeScript Playground and implement a function with explicit types, then run it.

tasks.title: Reflect on type errors
tasks.description: Note three situations where TypeScript prevented a bug you’d have made in plain JavaScript.

milestones.title: Web Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Create static pages with HTML, CSS, and basic client‑side interactivity.

tasks.title: Study HTML5 structure on MDN
tasks.description: Read the MDN guide on semantic HTML and build a simple page skeleton.

tasks.title: Style the page with CSS Grid
tasks.description: Follow a freeCodeCamp tutorial to layout the page using CSS Grid.

tasks.title: Add interactive DOM script
tasks.description: Write a small JavaScript file that toggles a class on button click.

tasks.title: Connect with a mentor on Discord
tasks.description: Join a #beginners channel, introduce yourself, and ask a question about layout.

milestones.title: Version Control Basics
milestones.outcome: Track code changes and collaborate using Git and GitHub.

tasks.title: Read Git basics on Git SCM
tasks.description: Learn about init, add, commit, and push commands from the official docs.

tasks.title: Initialize a repo for a demo project
tasks.description: Create a local Git repo, make two commits, and push to a new GitHub repository.

tasks.title: Practice branching workflow
tasks.description: Create a feature branch, modify a file, merge back, and resolve a simple conflict.

tasks.title: Reflect on commit messages
tasks.description: Write three guidelines for clear commit messages based on your experience.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Deepen expertise in front‑end, back‑end, data, and deployment technologies.

milestones.title: React (or Next.js) Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Build a single‑page app with components, state, and routing.

tasks.title: Watch Next.js tutorial on YouTube
tasks.description: Follow a free introductory video that creates a pages directory and dynamic routes.

tasks.title: Create a React component library
tasks.description: Build three reusable components (Button, Card, Modal) using functional components and hooks.

tasks.title: Implement client‑side routing
tasks.description: Add React Router (or Next.js pages) to navigate between Home, About, and Contact views.

tasks.title: Connect with a React community
tasks.description: Join the r/reactjs subreddit, read a recent discussion, and comment with a question.

tasks.title: Reflect on component design
tasks.description: Write a short note on when to use props vs. context in your components.

milestones.title: Node (or Django) Backend Basics
milestones.outcome: Create RESTful APIs that handle CRUD operations and authentication.

tasks.title: Read Express.js guide on MDN
tasks.description: Study the basics of setting up an Express server, routes, and middleware.

tasks.title: Build a simple CRUD API
tasks.description: Implement endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting a “tasks” resource, storing data in memory.

tasks.title: Add JWT authentication
tasks.description: Integrate jsonwebtoken to protect a route and issue tokens on login.

tasks.title: Watch Django tutorial on DjangoProject.com
tasks.description: Follow the official “Getting started” video to create a basic Django app.

tasks.title: Reflect on framework differences
tasks.description: List three pros and cons you observed between Express and Django.

milestones.title: SQL & Data Persistence
milestones.outcome: Design relational schemas and query data using SQL.

tasks.title: Study SQL basics on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Complete the introductory module covering SELECT, WHERE, and JOIN.

tasks.title: Design a relational schema for a blog
tasks.description: Sketch tables for Users, Posts, Comments with primary/foreign keys.

tasks.title: Create tables in PostgreSQL locally
tasks.description: Use psql to create the schema and insert sample rows.

tasks.title: Write complex queries
tasks.description: Craft a query that returns the latest 5 comments per post with author names.

tasks.title: Reflect on normalization
tasks.description: Explain why you chose third normal form for your schema.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply what you’ve learned to real‑world portfolio projects.

milestones.title: SaaS Billing App (Project)
milestones.outcome: Demonstrate end‑to‑end feature delivery from database to UI with payment flow.

tasks.title: Plan feature list in a markdown file
tasks.description: Outline user registration, subscription tiers, and admin dashboard.

tasks.title: Set up repo and CI pipeline
tasks.description: Initialize GitHub repo, add GitHub Actions for linting and tests.

tasks.title: Implement backend API with Node
tasks.description: Create routes for users, plans, and Stripe webhook handling.

tasks.title: Build React front‑end for subscription flow
tasks.description: Develop pages for plan selection, checkout, and account management.

tasks.title: Deploy to Render (free tier)
tasks.description: Configure a Render service to host both front‑end and back‑end, enable HTTPS.

tasks.title: Reflect on full‑stack integration
tasks.description: Write a brief post‑mortem on challenges linking payment API with DB.

milestones.title: Real‑Time Chat App (Project)
milestones.outcome: Show ability to handle websockets, persistence, and responsive UI.

tasks.title: Design data model for messages
tasks.description: Create tables for Users, Rooms, and Messages with timestamps.

tasks.title: Set up a Django Channels server
tasks.description: Configure routing and a consumer that broadcasts messages to a room.

tasks.title: Create React chat UI
tasks.description: Build components for message list, input box, and online users panel.

tasks.title: Integrate WebSocket client
tasks.description: Connect the React app to the Django Channels endpoint and handle events.

tasks.title: Deploy to Railway (free)
tasks.description: Push both back‑end and front‑end to Railway, set environment variables for secret keys.

tasks.title: Reflect on latency handling
tasks.description: Document three techniques you used to keep UI responsive under load.

milestones.title: Product Clone (Project)
milestones.outcome: Reproduce a popular SaaS UI and core functionality to demonstrate design fidelity.

tasks.title: Select a product and map core features
tasks.description: Choose a well‑known tool (e.g., Trello) and list its main boards, cards, and drag‑drop behavior.

tasks.title: Create component library matching UI
tasks.description: Implement reusable UI components that mimic the chosen product’s look and feel.

tasks.title: Build REST API for board data
tasks.description: Use Node or Django to expose endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting boards and cards.

tasks.title: Add drag‑and‑drop with React DnD
tasks.description: Integrate a library to allow moving cards between columns and persist changes via API.

tasks.title: Write unit tests for critical paths
tasks.description: Add Jest (or pytest) tests covering board creation and card movement.

tasks.title: Reflect on UI/UX decisions
tasks.description: Summarize what you kept, altered, or omitted compared to the original product.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, system design basics, and prepare for job or client interviews.

milestones.title: System Design Basics
milestones.outcome: Explain common architectures and trade‑offs for scalable web applications.

tasks.title: Read System Design Primer on GitHub
tasks.description: Study the overview of load balancers, caching, databases, and microservices.

tasks.title: Sketch a design for a URL shortener
tasks.description: Create a diagram showing components, data flow, and scaling points.

tasks.title: Discuss design with a peer
tasks.description: Share your diagram in a dev community forum and request feedback.

tasks.title: Write a short design doc
tasks.description: Summarize your choices, bottlenecks, and mitigation strategies in 300 words.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade‑offs
tasks.description: Identify three potential failure points and propose safeguards.

milestones.title: Advanced TypeScript & Testing
milestones.outcome: Write robust, typed code and ensure quality with automated tests.

tasks.title: Study advanced TypeScript types on TypeScript Docs
tasks.description: Learn about generics, conditional types, and utility types.

tasks.title: Refactor a component with generics
tasks.description: Take one of your earlier React components and add generic props for flexibility.

tasks.title: Add unit tests with Jest
tasks.description: Write test cases for the component’s rendering and interaction logic.

tasks.title: Set up CI linting and testing
tasks.description: Configure GitHub Actions to run ESLint and Jest on each push.

tasks.title: Reflect on test coverage
tasks.description: Record the percentage of code covered and note gaps to improve.

milestones.title: Deployment & DevOps Essentials
milestones.outcome: Deploy applications reliably and monitor them in production.

tasks.title: Read Docker basics on Docker Docs
tasks.description: Understand images, containers, and Dockerfiles through the official tutorial.

tasks.title: Containerize a Node app
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile, build an image, and run the container locally.

tasks.title: Deploy container to Fly.io (free tier)
tasks.description: Create a Fly.io app, push the image, and verify the live site.

tasks.title: Set up basic monitoring with UptimeRobot
tasks.description: Add a free monitor for your deployed URL and configure alerts.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior engineer
tasks.description: Request a short coffee chat to discuss deployment best practices.

tasks.title: Reflect on deployment workflow
tasks.description: Write three improvements you’d make to automate future releases.
